text.name: caption
text.text.content: Drag θ₁ and the two indices; make n₁ larger than n₂ and tilt past the critical angle to see total internal reflection.

path.name: theta1 arc
path.path.d: {= 'M 300 290 A 50 50 0 0 0 ' + fmt(300 - 50 * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2) + ' ' + fmt(340 - 50 * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2)}

path.name: theta2 arc
path.path.d: {= 'M 300 400 A 60 60 0 0 0 ' + fmt(300 + 60 * min(1, $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value), 2) + ' ' + fmt(340 + 60 * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2))), 2)}

text.name: theta2 label
text.transform2d.x: {= 300 + 84 * sin(max(atan2(min(1, $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value), sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))) / 2, 0.2)) - 6}
text.transform2d.y: {= 340 + 84 * cos(max(atan2(min(1, $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value), sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))) / 2, 0.2)) - 9}

path.name: incident ray
path.path.d: {= 'M ' + fmt(300 - 200 * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2) + ' ' + fmt(340 - 200 * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2) + ' L 300 340'}

path.name: refracted ray
path.path.d: {= 'M 300 340 L ' + fmt(300 + 200 * min(1, $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value), 2) + ' ' + fmt(340 + 200 * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2))), 2)}

group.name: refracted arrow
group.transform2d.rot: {= atan2(sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2))), min(1, $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value))}

path.name: reflected ray
path.path.d: {= 'M 300 340 L ' + fmt(300 + 200 * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2) + ' ' + fmt(340 - 200 * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180), 2)}
path.appearance.opacity: {= clamp(0.3 + 0.7 * ($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value > 1 ? 1 : pow(($n1.slider.value * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) - $n2.slider.value * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))) / ($n1.slider.value * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) + $n2.slider.value * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))), 2)), 0.3, 1)}

text.name: theta2 readout
text.text.content: {= $n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value > 1 ? 'none (TIR)' : fmt(atan2($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))) * 180 / pi, 1) + '°'}

text.name: reflectance readout
text.text.content: {= fmt(100 * ($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value > 1 ? 1 : pow(($n1.slider.value * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) - $n2.slider.value * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))) / ($n1.slider.value * cos($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) + $n2.slider.value * sqrt(max(0, 1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($theta1.slider.value * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2)))), 2)), 1) + ' %'}

text.name: reflectance note
text.text.content: Rₛ is the s-polarised Fresnel reflectance; the reflected ray's opacity follows it.

text.name: plot note
text.text.content: Grey line: θ₂ = θ₁ (no bending). With n₁ > n₂ the curve ends at the critical angle.

place.name: angle plot
place.title: θ₂ against θ₁
place.ys: {= atan2($n1.slider.value * sin($self.xs * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, sqrt(1 - pow($n1.slider.value * sin($self.xs * pi / 180) / $n2.slider.value, 2))) * 180 / pi}
